Hi Felix! Sure — the design review decision for count_transfers: a `None` line marks a hand-carried leg inside a hub (no truck). It's skipped when comparing lines, so L1 -> None -> L2 counts as one transfer, and L1 -> None -> L1 counts as no transfer at all. Let me know if you want me to walk through it.

Hi @ben - the critical_roads design-review decision I noted: if the network lists the same depot pair more than once (either orientation), treat them as physically separate roads (old road + new bypass), so closing one leaves the other open and such a pair is never critical. Hope that helps!
